_README: Two derived tables for the Actual Intelligence Labs post, in the site's {"table": ...} prose-block shape. The effort-ladder medians are NOT in STATS-CURRENT-2026-08-03.md (section 3 there is McNemar pair tables, not medians); they are recomputed from runner/results/results.jsonl with corpus_gates.summarizable_rows, bare runs, passing rows only, median tokens_out per model x effort, rounded half up. Command to reproduce is in _reproduce. The ceiling table condenses section 1's 25 Wilson cells to one row per model; Runs column sums to 267, the kept-row count.
_reproduce: python3 -c "import sys,json,statistics;from collections import defaultdict;from decimal import Decimal,ROUND_HALF_UP;sys.path.insert(0,'runner');import corpus_gates;rows=[json.loads(l) for l in open('runner/results/results.jsonl') if l.strip()];kept,_=corpus_gates.summarizable_rows(rows);b=[r for r in kept if not r.get('harness') and r['pass']];d=defaultdict(list);[d[(r['model'],r['effort'])].append(r['tokens_out']) for r in b];print({k:int(Decimal(str(statistics.median(v))).quantize(0,ROUND_HALF_UP)) for k,v in sorted(d.items())})"

table.caption: Median output tokens per solved run, bare invocation, by effort tier
